purposes.delay_seconds: Blue holds one request for three nearby active seconds so the player can move before a paid trip. Pauses and blocked signal support preserve the exact remaining delay; no catch-up or second queued request.
purposes.maximum_machines: Bounds fixture persistence and active presentation in this first local experiment.
purposes.cargo_units: A basket can carry a useful construction haul without adding a player carrying penalty.
purposes.sorter_input_units: Bounds the mixed batch the player deliberately puts into the chute.
purposes.sorter_tray_units: Full trays stop sorting without consuming or dropping an item.
purposes.sorter_batch_units: One hand operation visibly sorts a small useful batch.
purposes.energy_capacity: Four stored operations make the drum or pressure chamber useful while hand input remains readable.
purposes.winding_energy: One deliberate hand-wind stores one operation; no automatic energy is created.
purposes.trip_energy: A trip spends its energy once at departure, including a return with an empty basket.
purposes.bellows_energy: One release spends one hand-primed pressure operation.
purposes.maximum_span: A winch serves one cave mouth or ledge, rather than crossing the whole world.
purposes.signal_range: Stormglass links remain a small visible local experiment.
purposes.bellows_range: A bellows works the adjacent seam where its pulse can be seen.
purposes.cargo_metres_per_second: Basket travel is visible and brief enough for a practical local haul.
purposes.minimum_trip_seconds: Even very short spans have a visible departure and arrival.
purposes.maximum_coordinate: Rejects corrupted fixture poses well beyond any supported finite world.
purposes.pressure_source_strokes: One finite pocket can drive 24 firings, yielding 96 existing bricks before hand winding or relocation; it never replenishes.
purposes.feeder_input_units: Clay and ordinary fuel share a small explicit hopper; reserved contents retain room for exact cancellation.
purposes.feeder_output_units: Eight brick batches fit in the tray; a full tray stops before another firing consumes supplies.
purposes.feeder_batch_cycles: One local handle or Stormglass request starts at most four firings, requiring another deliberate start afterward.
purposes.feeder_cycle_seconds: Each active firing is visible while building nearby; pausing or unloading preserves fractional progress without offline catch-up.
purposes.feeder_attachment_range: The supported feeder serves one nearby player-built basic forge and one local pressure pocket, without a transport network.
purposes.ferrous_items: Only these ordinary iron ingredients follow the magnet; other materials go to the other tray.
